geez.source: Mermru English-Ge'ez parallel corpus (https://mermru.com/), via Bedru/Eng-Geez on the HuggingFace Hub
geez.note: Assembled for the V2 evaluation workflow. The published paper (Sec. 4.2) states that Ge'ez was evaluated only intrinsically due to the absence of parallel data, while its Table 3 reports an English-Ge'ez block. This set is not a reproduction of that block; see data/evaluation/geez/manifest.json and docs/geez_data_consistency_review.md.
